## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

Claim: the shift operators of the moment hierarchy have a strictly positive commutativity defect, so the hierarchy cannot be extended to higher degree while keeping positivity.

### Governing Obligation
Not supported: under normalization, positivity and actual rank equality the descended coordinate shift operators commute (operators_commute), so any defect must come from data failing those premises.

### Witness Audit
lean4/CommutativeFlatMoments.lean::operators_commute states Commute P Q for symmetric shifts with a cross-Gram symmetry hypothesis.
